terminal_reason: Duplicate of PI-20260926-96NDZSOD-0003 and fixed by the same change: scripts/ci/check_mandate_autoland.py passes ignore_cleanup_errors=True at both TemporaryDirectory sites and sets gc.auto 0 on the scratch repo (checked 2026-09-30).
what: scripts/ci/check_mandate_autoland.py --self-test intermittently exits 1 in CI with OSError [Errno 39] Directory not empty: 'objects' during TemporaryDirectory cleanup (git gc/maintenance still writing .git/objects in the scratch repo). Turned #14180 (pytest-run, job 109425165343) and #14087 (guards) red on diffs that do not touch it. Fix: TemporaryDirectory(ignore_cleanup_errors=True) at the self_test/_case sites and gc.auto=0 + maintenance.auto=false in _base_repo. SA-SEC asked to port it in #14180.
